title: 第123章 离宫求去
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

人家太子妃腆着大肚子亲自来谢罪领罚而来,他们也不好扯着妲己误国的理由大闹殿堂了。

最后这次朝堂哭丧到底是鸣金收兵了。

不过太子妃身为后宫女眷，没听陛下传讯便来到大殿之上，显然也违了祖制。

于是落云被陛下言语申斥一通,勒令回东宫修身养胎，不准擅自出宫。

那日回去的路上，香草和寄秋都心疼着自家的太子妃。

甚至连建康宫的宗氏听了都叹气摇头：“这宫里的女人，还得时不时给爷们顶锅。落云入主东宫到现在，都未曾召见自己的父亲，却还是受了父族兄弟的带累……”

说到这，她看了看在自己跟前侍奉的二儿媳郑氏，不放心地叮咛道：“现在朝堂上漫天的官司,你也要注意，嫁入我们皇家得事事谨小慎微,不可给你夫君惹祸！”

郑氏只含笑听着,点头表示婆婆教训得是,她平日里一定得注意些。

跟外柔内刚的大儿媳妇比，这个书香门第出身的二儿媳妇就恭顺和善多了。

因为之前改诗集的事儿,韩逍婚后没少给这新妇冷脸看，可是郑氏却无半句怨词，只每日微笑迎着二皇子的冷脸。二皇子故意冷着她，她也不急不躁，只静心看着自己的书，写着自己的字。

这份家教涵养,也是无人能及。

就连大哥韩临风都劝慰韩逍：“父皇如果没有登基，像弟妹这般才之艳艳的大儒女子，你是够也够不上的。若是你不喜这样，也别耽搁了人家,早日散了，再娶些阿谀奉承的俗人来配你。反正郑家女不愁嫁，不必吊死在你这冰窖里！”

时间久了，韩逍也有点泄劲儿，觉得自己怪没意思的，这几日跟郑氏的关系倒是有些缓和。

可惜二皇子夫妻之情刚刚缓和，东宫太子的夫妻和谐，却终是被打破了。

陛下权衡利弊，虽然查明了苏归雁并未徇私舞弊，懈怠了职权，可为了缓和与世家的关系，最终还是下达了惩处苏归雁的圣旨，将他左迁贬斥北地苦寒之地。

这道圣旨一下，帝师后人总算顺气过来，觉得自己找回了脸面。而其余的世家也是幸灾乐祸。

被帝师后人这么一闹，那均田制的权威也大打折扣，只要各个乡县的豪绅打出正经名目来阻止那帮穷鬼圈地，那么这新政也就渐渐废止了。

如果大部分流民都有田种，那还了得？世家名下大片的田地上哪里雇佣佃农耕种？就算能雇到人，也不是以前低廉的价格了！

现在苏归雁被贬斥，便是新帝向世家低头的第一步。

圣旨下达的那晚，爱弟心切的落云也许是心中一时郁积难忍，替弟弟打抱不平，居然跟太子韩临风大吵了一架。砸摔东西的声音。就连外院的宫人都能听得见。

怀夏当初因为怀着别样的心思，被太子妃申斥了一通，要轰撵她出去。后来怀夏哭哭啼啼地要求寄秋帮她求情，这宫里的宫人都是熬资历的，算起来，怀夏若是跟香草她们一样，等到来年再出宫，便算是服满差役，可以再额外得一笔安家费。

最后，寄秋仗着胆子求了求情。也许是太子妃当时消气了，总算是靠着这两年的主仆情分，勉强同意她留了下来。

虽然怀夏再也进不得内院，但是可以在外院里做一些粗浅的活计，只待熬到了的时间，便可以跟香草她们一起出宫了。

那日，她在门口侧耳听着屋内的吵闹声，还有太子韩临风先是耐着性子小声劝慰，可是苏落云却丝毫没有让步之意，二人的声音越来越大。

最后太子显然也是劝烦了，竟然盛怒之下痛骂苏归雁小子不识时务，见识浅薄，非要把这鸡毛蒜皮的小事儿演成朝堂上的大风大雨。

也许是因为太子动怒，苏落云终于不再争吵，却开始哽咽抽泣，然后怀夏便看到韩临风一脸怒色地匆匆而去。

过了一会儿，只见寄秋也一脸丧气地端着水盆走了出来。

怀夏连忙一把拉拽住她，悄声问这是怎么了？成婚两年多都没见两个主子脸红过，怎么今日吵得这么厉害。

寄秋叹了一口气小声道：“陛下为了止住前朝的风波，决定将苏归雁贬斥到北边，听说那边之穷困比梁州还甚，常年缺水，一年到头澡都洗不上。太子妃心疼弟弟，想要太子在陛下面前求求情，不要将弟弟贬得那么远。可是太子却说眼下朝堂非议甚多，陛下的日子也不好过，他身为皇储怎么可能让父皇为难呢？就这么你一言我一语的吵了起来。唉，我也从没见过太子妃哭得这么厉害，那俩眼都红肿了。”

怀夏心有戚戚，也是叹气点了点头小声道：“一会儿你和香草可得好好劝劝太子妃。”

寄秋也点了点头，一脸无奈地将手里的铜盆递给了华夏之后，便转身回去了。

那一天余下的时间里，怀夏往内院送东西到时候，都时不时听到苏落云哽咽的声音。

怀夏知道，太子妃的软处除了太子，就是她那个亲弟弟，现在弟弟遭此大难，也难怪太子妃伤心了。

这太子一走，便是一夜未归。到了第二天时，怀夏刚刚起床，就听着那院儿传来咣当一声响，紧接着就听到了太子妃紧绷的声音，高声问香草现在是几时了，怎么天还这么黑？

太子妃说这话时，天已经大亮，正是艳阳高照之时。

待香草慌忙进屋后，不久就听到香草悲泣地嚷道：“我的大姑娘，您这是怎么了？怎么眼疾又犯了呢？我昨日都劝你不要哭得太厉害，你非是不听……看看这可如何是好！”

再接下来就是内院一阵兵荒马乱，那常年给落云看病的老郎中也是一路连跑带喘地拎着药箱子入了内院，不多时，那老先生便是摇着头，一路叹气地走了。

怀夏守着门口，借着给内院送水的功夫又一把扯住寄秋，问太子妃是不是生病了，为什么她看老郎中的脸色不佳。

寄秋愁眉苦脸地看了看左右无人，然后小声道：“我只跟你说，你可莫告诉旁人，我们太子妃的眼疾……似乎又犯了。”

怀夏听得都瞪圆了眼睛，眼疾又犯了？那太子妃岂不是又看不见东西，成了瞎子？

Page (1/3)

The Crown Princess came in person with a big belly to apologize and receive the punishment, so it was not easy for them to make a fuss in the palace by citing Daji's reason for betraying the country.

In the end, the mourning in the court was the result of Ming Jin withdrawing his troops.

However, as a female member of the harem, the Crown Princess came to the main hall without hearing His Majesty's message, which obviously violated the ancestral rules.

So Luoyun was reprimanded by His Majesty and ordered to go back to the East Palace to cultivate himself and raise his fetus, and was not allowed to leave the palace without permission.

On the way back that day, both Vanilla and Ji Qiu felt sorry for their princess.

Even the Zong clan of Jiankang Palace sighed and shook his head after hearing this: "The women in this palace have to take the blame for the men from time to time. Until Luoyun entered the East Palace, he has not summoned his father, but he is still affected by his father's brothers..."

Speaking of this, she looked at her second daughter-in-law, Mrs. Zheng, who was serving in front of her, and warned her uneasily: "Now that the court is filled with lawsuits, you must also pay attention. When you marry into our royal family, you must be cautious in everything and don't cause trouble for your husband!"

Mrs. Zheng just listened with a smile and nodded, indicating that her mother-in-law had taught her that she must pay more attention to it.

Compared with the eldest daughter-in-law who is soft on the outside but tough on the inside, the second daughter-in-law from a scholarly family is much more submissive and kind.

Because of the previous revision of the poetry collection, Han Xiao often gave the bride a cold look after their marriage, but Zheng didn't complain at all, and only smiled every day to meet the second prince's cold face.The second prince deliberately kept her cold, but she was not impatient and just calmly looked at her book and wrote her own words.

This kind of family education and self-cultivation is also unparalleled.

Even the eldest brother Han Linfeng comforted Han Xiao: "If my father had not ascended the throne, you would not be able to reach a talented and beautiful Confucian woman like your siblings. If you don't like this, don't delay the family, break up as soon as possible, and marry some flattering common people to match you. Anyway, the Zheng family's daughter has no need to worry about getting married, and there is no need to hang her in your ice cellar!"

As time passed, Han Xiao became a little discouraged and felt that he was boring. The relationship with Zheng had somewhat eased in the past few days.

Unfortunately, the relationship between the second prince and his wife had just eased, but the harmony between the prince and his wife in the East Palace was finally broken.

His Majesty weighed the pros and cons, and although he found out that Su Guiyan had not engaged in malpractice for personal gain or slacked off in his duties, in order to ease the relationship with the aristocratic family, he finally issued an imperial edict to punish Su Guiyan, moving him to the left and denouncing him to the bitter cold of the north.

With this imperial edict, the descendants of the Imperial Master finally came to terms with themselves and felt that they had regained their face.The rest of the aristocratic families were also gloating.

After being made such a fuss by the emperor's descendants, the authority of the land equalization system was greatly reduced. As long as the wealthy gentry in each township and county used serious names to prevent the poor people from encircling their land, then this new policy would gradually be abolished.

If most of the refugees have farmland, then what’s the point?Where do they hire tenant farmers to farm the large fields owned by the family?Even if we can hire people, the prices are not as low as before!

Now that Su Guiyan was reprimanded, this was the first step for the new emperor to bow to the noble family.

On the night when the imperial edict was issued, Luoyun, who loved his brother so much, perhaps because of a moment of unbearable depression in his heart, fought for his brother's injustice, and actually had a big quarrel with the prince Han Linfeng.The sound of things being smashed.Even the palace people in the outer courtyard can hear it.

Huai Xia was reprimanded by the Crown Princess because she had other thoughts, and wanted to kick her out.Later, Huaixia cried and asked Jiqiu to intercede for her. The palace servants in this palace all had seniority. After all, if Huaixia was like Vanilla and the others, when she leaves the palace next year, she would have completed her service and could get an extra settling-in allowance.

Finally, Ji Qiu took the courage to plead for mercy.Perhaps the Crown Princess had calmed down at that time, and finally relied on the master-servant relationship of the past two years to reluctantly agree to her stay.

Although Huaixia can no longer enter the inner courtyard, she can do some simple work in the outer courtyard. As long as the time is up, she can leave the palace with Vanilla and the others.

That day, she listened at the door to the noise in the house, and Prince Han Linfeng patiently whispered comfort at first, but Su Luoyun had no intention of giving in, and their voices became louder and louder.

In the end, the prince was obviously fed up with the persuasion, and he angrily scolded Su Guiyan for being ignorant of current affairs and shallow, insisting on turning this trivial matter into a storm in the court.

Perhaps because the prince was angry, Su Luoyun finally stopped arguing, but began to choke and sob. Then Huaixia saw Han Linfeng hurried away with an angry look on his face.

After a while, Ji Qiu came out carrying a basin with a dejected look on his face.

Huai Xia quickly grabbed her and asked quietly what was going on?I haven't seen the two masters blush in more than two years of marriage, so why are they so quarreling today?

Ji Qiu sighed and whispered: "In order to stop the turmoil in the previous dynasty, Your Majesty decided to relegate Su Guiyan to the north. I heard that the poverty there is even worse than Liangzhou. There is a year-round lack of water and you can't take a bath all year round. The Crown Princess feels sorry for her younger brother and wants the Crown Prince to beg for mercy in front of Your Majesty. Don't send your brother to the north."The younger brother was demoted so far.But the prince said that there is a lot of criticism in the court and his Majesty's life is not easy.How could he, as the crown prince, embarrass his father?Alas, I have never seen the prince crying so hard. Her eyes were red and swollen."

Huai Xia felt sad and sighed, nodded and whispered: "You and Vanilla will have to persuade the Crown Princess in a while."

Ji Qiu also nodded, and handed the copper basin in his hand to Hua Xia with a look of helplessness, then turned around and went back.

During the rest of that day, when Huaixia was delivering things to the inner courtyard, she would hear Su Luoyun's choking sounds from time to time.

Huai Xia knew that the Crown Princess's weakest spot, apart from the Crown Prince, was her biological brother. Now that his brother had suffered such a disaster, it was no wonder that the Crown Princess was sad.

As soon as the prince left, he did not return all night.On the second day, Huaixia had just gotten up when she heard a bang from the courtyard, and then heard the princess's tense voice, asking Vanilla loudly what time it was and why was it still so dark?

When the Crown Princess said this, it was already bright and the sun was shining brightly.

After Vanilla hurriedly entered the house, she soon heard Vanilla crying sadly: "My eldest girl, what's wrong with you? Why do you have an eye problem again? I advised you not to cry too much yesterday, but you refused to listen... Let's see what happens!"

Then there was a chaos in the inner courtyard. The old doctor who had been treating Luo Yun all year round also ran and panted all the way carrying the medicine box into the inner courtyard. After a while, the old gentleman shook his head and left with a sigh.

Huaixia guarded the door, and while delivering water to the inner courtyard, he grabbed Jiqiu and asked the princess if she was sick and why she looked bad at the old doctor's face.

Ji Qiu looked at the people around her with a sad expression, and then whispered: "I'm just telling you, please don't tell others that our Crown Princess's eye disease... seems to have happened again."

Huaixia's eyes widened when he heard this. Did he suffer from eye disease again?Could it be that the Crown Princess could not see things again and became blind?
